comments.body: Closing as a duplicate of #1899, which fixes the same uncaught `JSON::ParserError` on a non-JSON 200 response from the LLM API, with broader test coverage (HTML, truncated JSON, and empty bodies) and an implementation that reuses the existing `RuntimeError` handling path in `LlmService#post` rather than adding a separate rescue clause. Thanks for catching this — the fix just landed via #1899 instead.
